prediction_check: V, 600 papers; differences are paired per-paper means; prefcc = its seed-1 V scores. 32 arm intervals: 26 held, 6 missed. r4a (filter c_teacher): vs C 4 of 4 held (fact +0.0317, claim +0.0030 at the upper edge of [-0.006, +0.003], length +0.0279, ROUGE-L -0.0008); vs prefcc 2 of 4 (fact -0.0110 and length -0.0098 held; claim +0.0045 [+0.0007, +0.0084] just above [-0.005, +0.004], ROUGE-L +0.0042 [+0.0014, +0.0071] just above [-0.001, +0.004], better than predicted). Neither falsification clause fired: fact is not more than 0.020 below prefcc, and ROUGE-L is above prefcc with its interval excluding zero. r4b (claim weight 3): 8 of 8 held (vs C fact +0.0370, claim -0.0072, length +0.0445, ROUGE-L -0.0067; vs prefcc fact -0.0048, claim -0.0057 [-0.0094, -0.0022], length +0.0069, ROUGE-L -0.0018). Neither falsification clause fired: claim share is below prefcc's, and fact is not more than 0.025 below. r4c (2 pairs per paper): vs C 3 of 4 (length +0.0871 outside [-0.07, +0.04]); vs prefcc 3 of 4 (fact +0.0148 [+0.0013, +0.0278] held; length +0.0486 outside [-0.10, 0.00]). I expected it to write shorter; it wrote longer. Its clause asked for fact at least +0.005 above prefcc at a length within 0.03; fact is +0.0148 but length is +0.049, so the clause cannot be read cleanly and the fact gain is confounded with length. r4d (all three): vs C 3 of 4 (length +0.0478 above +0.04); vs prefcc 3 of 4 (fact -0.0152 [-0.0289, -0.0017] held; length +0.0102 above +0.01). FALSIFIED by its own clause: fact more than 0.015 below prefcc's. Blend r4cw75: it kept 77% of r4c's fact gain over C (predicted at least 80%: missed) and recovered 33% of r4c's ROUGE-L deficit (predicted at least a third: held at the edge). Length came back only 19% of the way to C's. Pattern in the misses: all 4 length misses are on the long side. The preview's length measure (rejected/chosen median) did not predict the direction of output length.

finalists.name: r4b
finalists.why: This is my pre-registered faithfulness finalist: r4d was falsified, and of r4a and r4b, r4b keeps more fact. On V its fact is level with prefcc: -0.0048 against seed 1, and -0.0003 against the mean of prefcc's two seeds on V. It moved the training grader's claim share the most of any arm ever scored on V (-0.0072 vs C, -0.0057 [-0.0094, -0.0022] vs prefcc). V's claim share does not predict the test (rho 0.14), so this shows only that the mechanism engaged; whether faithfulness improved is for the test. Main risk: criterion 3. Its V ROUGE-L (-0.0067 vs C) is below both of prefcc's seeds (-0.0049, -0.0058), and the test BERTScore drop has been 1.3-2.4x the ROUGE-L drop, so the two-seed BERTScore is about a coin flip against -0.010. NLI, predicted outside the schema: -0.025 to -0.005 vs C (prefcc -0.024). Probability of replacing prefcc: about 0.1. Test predictions are for the two-seed mean; length_ratio is absolute, relative to the teacher.

finalists.name: r4a
finalists.why: This finalist goes beyond my pre-written plan, which named r4c as the recall finalist if its V fact was at least about +0.015 above prefcc. r4c reached +0.0148, but it wrote 0.049 longer than prefcc. Earlier arms' fact-vs-length slopes on V (0.06-0.19 per unit of length ratio, from within-recipe seed pairs and round 1 against preflc) put about +0.003 to +0.012 of that gain down to length, and r4c's own clause conditioned the reading on equal length. Longer, less teacher-like output (ROUGE-L -0.0066 vs C) also makes criteria 3 and 4 unlikely for r4c, so I drop it. r4a gives the clearest result on V, in the direction predicted: ROUGE-L +0.0042 [+0.0014, +0.0071] above prefcc, back to C's level (-0.0008), which is the best criterion-3 margin of any preference arm. It also pairs with r4b as a discriminating test. The training grader (Gemma) rates r4a worse than prefcc on claim share (+0.0045) and r4b better (-0.0057). The blind auditor said Gemma's contrast in sample-chosen pairs is not real. If r4a matches or beats r4b on the test's unsupported share and NLI, the auditor was right and r4b's gain on Gemma is partly learned grader quirks; if r4b wins, Gemma's flags in samples were real. Risk: recall. V fact is -0.0110 [-0.0235, +0.0031] vs prefcc seed 1 (correct share -0.0136, interval below zero) and -0.0056 vs prefcc's two-seed V mean, so rule 2's 'not worse on recall' may fail. Its second seed is the cheapest (940 pairs, about 7 h). NLI, predicted: -0.025 to -0.005 vs C. Probability of replacing prefcc: about 0.1. Test predictions are for the two-seed mean; length_ratio is absolute.
